**Description:**
Open 20 ton - 40 ton Trucks (ta) and compare live SEO headings with the snapshot. Allure and artifacts/seo-structure-report.xlsx show expected vs actual so a changed heading can be copied into test data after it is confirmed.

Every stored heading on 20 ton - 40 ton Trucks (ta) is still present with the same tag. Extra or missing headings fail the check; order on the page may differ.

1. Open 20 ton - 40 ton Trucks (ta)
2. Expand Read More if the About block is collapsed
3. Compare live headings with the stored snapshot
